budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Accountant's budget would rise to replace the retiring principal clerk with an assistant accountant, with four added hours.
budget_items.quote: there would be an increase of $4,912 in the town accountant's budget to replace the retiring principal clerk

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The technology budget would rise to cover an outside consultant and a Microsoft 365 upgrade, with network and infrastructure upgrades; grant applications are pending.
budget_items.quote: the technology budget would increase by $65,352 to cover hiring an outside consultant

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town's share of Medicare rises, offset by reductions in group health insurance and the Monty Tech Assessment.
budget_items.quote: an increase in the town's share of medicare by $39,935

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New-growth revenue adjustments and sewer enterprise changes together were described as making a balanced town budget.
budget_items.quote: revenue adjustments reflecting new growth along with changes in the sewer enterprise budget totaled $156,487

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Payment of technology invoices not known until after FY21 closed out, recommended for approval.
budget_items.quote: concerning payment of prior year expenses totaling $7,519 in technology invoices

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY21 technology budget closed out at a stated figure, of which a stated amount covered salaries; the committee judged enough remained for the invoices.
budget_items.quote: the fy21 technology budget closed out at $72,000 with $30,000 to cover salaries

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The article would raise the senior exemption from $750 to $1,000 and adjust income and asset limits; members said the wording appeared misleading.
budget_items.quote: adjust the exemption amount from $750 to $1,000 for those single seniors with incomes of $31,000 or less

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated impact of the exemption change would be covered by the overlay account.
budget_items.quote: the adjustment would have an estimated impact of $7,500, which could be covered by the overlay account

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Sewer Enterprise fund would pay for more hours for the assistant to the Sewer Business Manager, making the position benefitted.
budget_items.quote: ms. lemieux explained the fund will provide an increase in hours for the assistant to sewer business manager to make it a benefitted position.

budget_items.topic: Article G: Sewer capital reserve transfer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Sewer Commission would transfer a set-aside amount into its Capital Reserve Stabilization Fund; recommended for approval.
budget_items.quote: sewer commission to transfer $14,875 into their capital reserve stabilization fund.

budget_items.topic: Articles K and L: T.C. Passios building debt
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The debt exclusion for Article K was stated; no known values yet existed for tearing down and rebuilding the building.
budget_items.quote: the debt exclusion for article k is $23,570,000

budget_items.topic: Article L: T.C. Passios building figure
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A $250,000 figure for Article L was stated and may change once the architect provides an actual number.
budget_items.quote: the $250,000 figure may change as she anticipated an actual number from the architect

budget_items.topic: Articles K and L: T.C. Passios building values
budget_items.what_was_recorded: No known values existed for tearing down and rebuilding the T.C. Passios building; figures existed for Article K.
budget_items.quote: there are currently no known values on tearing down and rebuilding the t.c. passios building
